sources: with an unborn HEAD (git.head_missing) the HEAD vectors are skipped and .gitmodules is read from the index; manifest, devcontainer and projects checks read the working tree; Git checks read the index (ls-files --stage), the HEAD tree (ls-tree) and the committed .gitmodules blob (cat-file), matching the resolver, which reads committed objects
rules: valid is true exactly when no finding has severity error
every code is area.reason, lowercase with underscores
a Git failure or an unavailable Git never downgrades to a warning when .git is a real directory (git.listing_failed and git.unavailable are errors)

codes.note: symlink, special file, unreadable or non-regular
unknown/missing field, wrong type, schema_version not integer 1
devcontainer_path or projects_path breaks the canonical path rule (including case variants of .git)
userinfo or token in project.url; never echoed
symlink component, outside root, special or unreadable
git absent or too old (or macOS installer shim) while .git is a real directory; Git-derived checks did not run, so the result is never valid
.git is a symlink or gitfile, or contains commondir or objects/info/alternates
git call failed, timed out or output unparsable although .git is a real directory
index or tree listing beyond its bound
HEAD tree path with a non-canonical or case-folded .git component
.gitmodules not a regular blob/file (mode other than 100644/100755 or symlink)
duplicate path or url in one entry
key other than path and url (resolver rejects)
working-tree .gitmodules differs from the HEAD blob
not https://, ssh:// or scp-like user@host:path; relative, file:, ext::
any https userinfo or a password; value never echoed
more than 200 findings; counts stay exact
manifest project declaration without a pinned gitlink at its path; not creation-ready (FR-049)

unborn_head: HEAD is unborn exactly when rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD exits 1 with empty stderr and symbolic-ref -q HEAD names a ref that does not exist; every other non-zero exit, timeout or unparsable output is git.listing_failed.
git_invocation: seven fixed vectors: --version, symbolic-ref -q HEAD, rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD, ls-files --stage -z, ls-tree -r -z HEAD, cat-file blob HEAD:.gitmodules (only when the HEAD tree lists it), cat-file blob :.gitmodules (only with an unborn HEAD and when the index lists it); protocol.<name>.allow=never for file, git, ssh, http, https, ext; GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL set to a name matching no protocol; GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1
